title: Prepare (before starting Fusion)
setup:
- A **private** test repository on GitHub with nothing you need in it (it receives test branches and commits), and a second one for step 5. `python scripts/live/make_test_repos.py` can create them (see its help).
- A fine-grained token for **only** the first repository (Contents: Read and write), for step 10.
- The previous release's ZIP (`Push_To_GitHub-0.4.0.zip`) and the candidate ZIP, unpacked into two separate folders outside Fusion's AddIns folder.
- In Fusion: the test designs from `tests/live/FTG_TestDesigns` (an inch design with a 10 mm cube, a multi-body design with a hidden body, a design with characters Windows doesn't allow), and a second design you can insert into the first as a linked component.
- Optional: a folder inside OneDrive or Dropbox (step 13), a second Windows account (step 16), a Mac and the Community Store (step 17).
- Note the other add-ins you normally run (K7).

title: Start on the previous release
setup: 1. Install 0.4.0 (unpack it into the AddIns folder), Run it, and tick **Run on Startup**.\n2. Set up the first test repository with 0.4.0 and push once. This creates the old settings file and the repository-root `CHANGELOG.md` that later steps check.

title: Update in the same Fusion session (R-25)
First backup with the candidate (existing repository)
setup: Back up the inch design to the repository from step 1 with Fusion design + STEP + STL.

title: New repository and first-time setup
setup: Use the second private test repository, or the first with a new local folder.

title: History modes, links and Check My Setup
Background push and cancel
setup: Use a large export (several formats, high STL refinement) or a slow network so a push takes a while.

title: Edit, Remove, failures and network loss
Restart Fusion
setup: 1. With the duplicate copy from K6 still installed and **Run on Startup** ticked for both, **quit Fusion**.\n2. While Fusion is closed, copy `.fusion_git_repos.json` to a safe place, then replace its contents with `{not json`.\n3. Start Fusion.

title: Documentation by the book, and screenshots
Clean installation, load time and uninstall
setup: On a second Windows account (or after W4's uninstall), with no settings from earlier steps.

title: Community Store and macOS
setup: Only where available. macOS is Experimental; record the Fusion build.

title: Usability sessions (separate)
setup: Three or more people who have never used Git, one at a time, following [`docs/USABILITY_TEST.md`](../docs/USABILITY_TEST.md). Record each session's sheet as the evidence.

title: The final release package
setup: With the release candidate's ZIP from the Release workflow.
